projects.name: 3look
projects.description:
3look is an artificial intelligence-based app that allows users to create and publish social media content, mostly memes and GIFs, with the ability to publish directly to platforms like X (formerly Twitter) for a reward based on results.

It provides a studio for content creators where users generate branded or custom content using AI tools to quickly generate ideas, replace faces with NFT or crypto assets and publish, while an AI scoring system transparently assesses impact, distributing revenue without the need for constant interaction.

Developed as a SocialFi project on ApeChain within the ApeCoin ecosystem, it turns user-generated content into rewarding assets on the blockchain, with partnerships expanding to networks such as the Ice Open Network for decentralized social tiers.

activities.description:
Tempo [launched](https://x.com/tempo/status/1998407701366505710?s=20) testnet! We can interact with the testnet and become early adopters. Rewards for this activity have not been announced. Transactions can only be made on unofficial sites (created by third-party developers), so DYOR! We will update the guide when more dapps are available.

 

1. Go to [site](https://docs.tempo.xyz/quickstart/faucet), connect your wallet, add the Tempo test network to it and request test tokens. Then add them to the token list:
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/tempo1765546480169.png)

2. Send test tokens to other wallets periodically.

3. Send GMs and make a deplay on [onchaingm](https://onchaingm.com?ref=0xc021F43DABfB021705646f412B8c9c3912219922):
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/tempo_11765546766713.png)

4. Buy a domain on Tempo's test network [here](https://infinityname.com/):
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/tempo_21765546834335.png)

5. Connect your wallet and create a stablecoin [here](https://docs.tempo.xyz/guide/stablecoin-dex/executing-swaps):
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/dsffsdf1770041306084.png)

6. Create a test token and add [liquidity](https://docs.tempo.xyz/guide/stablecoin-dex/managing-fee-liquidity):
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/dsadjkasd1770041425063.png)

7. Make some [swaps](https://docs.tempo.xyz/guide/stablecoin-dex/executing-swaps):
![](https://img.cryptorank.io/image-hub/dasjidasa1770041446934.png)

Superboard [announced ](https://x.com/Superboard_/status/1999810251529523468) a campaign in which we can additionally interact with the Tempo testnet.

 

1. Go to [Superboard ](https://superboard.xyz/campaigns/tempo-testnet-exploration) and complete the tasks:

projects.name: Tempo
projects.description: Tempo is an EVM-compliant Layer 1 (L1) blockchain designed for payment processing. It does not replace universal blockchains, but offers solutions for high-volume payment scenarios. These include predictable low fees in a dedicated payment segment, support for various stablecoins, built-in stablecoin exchange, high throughput, low latency, private transactions, payment memos supporting standards such as ISO 20022, and compliance mechanisms.

Tenbin Labs is a project working in the field of tokenization of financial assets. The project considers mechanisms of onchain settlements, asset management and interaction between system participants

projects.description: The Invention Network is a holding company that builds businesses in markets dominated by platforms that take a large share of users' revenue (e.g., online earning). It builds models where users become co-owners through the $INVENT token: a minimum of 50% of the companies' revenue is distributed to token holders in real United States dollars (USD). The network holds invention contests and missions to find ideas, attracts contributions from token holders and referrals, and develops portfolio companies (e.g., Invent Money).

Vibe Trading is an open-ended futures trading platform specializing in the placement and trading of low market capitalization tokens, memcoins and utility tokens with free and instant placement. Projects or token holders deposit their own tokens into the vault to provide an open-ended marketplace - with no minimum deposit, no USDC/ETH/SOL pairing, and no placement fees - allowing for instant trading with up to 60x leverage.

Traders can utilize features such as Ape Mode for one-click orders, drag-and-drop elements on the chart, hotkeys, and volume-based rakebacks. Depositors (often project teams) receive the majority of trading commissions in perpetuity due to the volume generated on their deposited perpetual tokens, utilizing idle treasury tokens.
